plugins.name: orca-workflows
plugins.description: Supervised multi-agent workflows for the Orca CLI: research swarms, parallel lens-based code review, and DAG-based builds with decision gates.

plugins.name: jev-dispatch
plugins.description: Route agent tasks to the right harness, model, and effort level using a TypeSafe Jev judgment battery and a pure-code dispatch policy (MCP server + skill).

plugins.name: clarify-requirements
plugins.description: Clarify vague or high-stakes requests before building: explore the repo first, ask a few high-impact questions with recommended defaults, log assumptions, and hand off a short requirements brief.

plugins.name: debug-root-cause
plugins.description: Debug with method, not guesses: reproduce and isolate the failure, gather evidence, run a hypothesis ledger with minimal experiments, fix the root cause behind a failing test, verify green, and write a short bug report — for any concrete test, build, CI, or runtime failure.

plugins.name: compound-retros
plugins.description: Turn each agent session into reusable project knowledge: capture short structured solution notes (bug lessons, conventions, decisions, pitfalls — including lessons from user corrections), recall the few relevant ones before similar work, and curate the store against rot — each loop makes the next one smarter.

plugins.name: jev-gate
plugins.description: Gate agent tool calls before they run: plain-code lock rules ask before dangerous commands, a REUSE ledger stops unchanged expensive re-runs, and TypeSafe Jev judges the gray zone. Runs in shadow mode first (hooks + review skill).

plugins.name: spec-readiness-gate
plugins.description: Score a worker task spec before dispatch: a TypeSafe Jev battery checks the five contract fields and a pure-code policy returns dispatch, clarify (naming the weak fields), or escalate. Shadow mode first (MCP server + skill).

plugins.name: compact-nudge
plugins.description: Nudge the user to run /compact once the session context passes a token threshold, with a ready-to-edit /compact command drafted from the conversation. Claude Code only (function hooks); never compacts on its own.

plugins.name: launch-video
plugins.description: Turn the current project or a website URL into a short, polished, shareable launch video using HyperFrames.
